priorityList: Fire Breath is always cast at Empower level 1 to maximize the damage of Consume Flame
Pyre on everything above 3 targets, switch to Disintegrate if the pack is down to 2 targets or less
Living Flame cast at least once between every Fire Breath cast in order to consume Leaping Flames
Eternity Surge cast when you have none of the above available
Use Dragonrage on cooldown as it is the main cooldown
Use Fire Breath and Eternity Surge on cooldown during Dragonrage to extend its duration
Use Living Flame and Azure Strike as filler spells to generate Essence Burst
Use Hover effectively to cast spells on the move
Use Fire Breath and Eternity Surge early and often
